Dire Weasel

Animal · 3 hexes · SM +1 Dire Weasel [Monster Manual, page 65]

The same long, low, flexible build as a common weasel, scaled up to the size of a horse, with a broad mustelid head, amber eyes and long ivory canines. It latches on and drinks, and it keeps the smaller kind's habit of killing well past the point of any need for food.
